## CV Screening Automation
1. Send a CV file to the Webhook as multipart/form-data using the field name `data`.
2. The workflow extracts text from the uploaded file.
3. Edit the job criteria in the Code node before using it.
4. The Code node returns a transparent keyword-match score and a preliminary category.

Starter workflow: no AI API key required. It screens text only and does not make a hiring decision.
